title: Google Ads vs Social Media Ads for Salon Owners - Barton Interactive

facts.fact: The article states that when a searcher types a known brand, product, or service name into Google, the advertiser's ad can appear near the search results on the results page.
facts.quote: When this happens, it is possible for your ad to appear near the search results on a Google search result page.

facts.fact: The article states that Google offers bumper ads on YouTube videos as an option for businesses seeking to build brand awareness.
facts.quote: Google does offer other advertising options for businesses seeking to build brand awareness and start creating an audience (such as bumper ads on Youtube videos)
